data.name: Toast.NotWorking.LogCapped
data.value: Hearthstone stopped writing its log. Restart Hearthstone.

data.name: Toast.NotWorking.NoSignal
data.value: No Recruit phase was found in this game. Kindly Bartender may need an update; check About for a new version.

data.name: Toast.SetupNeeded.Body

data.name: Tray.Status.DoNotDisturb

data.name: Setup.Intro
data.value: Kindly Bartender tells you when hero selection or a Recruit phase starts while you’re in another window. It reads Hearthstone’s log, which Hearthstone writes only after two of its settings files are changed.

data.name: Setup.Files.Note
data.value: Only these settings change. Other settings in the files stay as they are.

data.name: Setup.Risk.Body
data.value: Kindly Bartender is an unofficial fan project, not made or endorsed by Blizzard Entertainment. Blizzard’s End User License Agreement forbids programs it hasn’t authorized from reading game data. Deck trackers have read the same log for years, but that doesn’t mean Blizzard permits it. Blizzard could take action against your account. Use Kindly Bartender at your own risk.

data.name: Setup.BringToFront
data.value: Bring Hearthstone to the front when a phase starts

data.name: Setup.BringToFront.Note
data.value: Your typing stays in the window you’re using.

data.name: Setup.DoNotDisturb
data.value: When Windows Do not disturb is on, notifications may be hidden. To let them through, add Kindly Bartender to priority notifications in Windows settings.

data.name: Setup.Folder.Missing
data.value: Hearthstone wasn’t found. Choose the folder that contains Hearthstone.exe.

data.name: Setup.Folder.Invalid
data.value: This folder doesn’t contain Hearthstone.exe. Choose another folder.

data.name: Setup.RestartNeeded
data.value: Log settings are set up. Restart Hearthstone to start notifications.

data.name: Setup.Elevation.Cancelled
data.value: The log size limit wasn’t removed because administrator permission wasn’t given. Select Agree and set up to try again.

data.name: Setup.Failed
data.value: The log settings couldn’t be changed. Close Hearthstone and try again.

data.name: Setup.NotEditable
data.value: A log settings file is read-only or saved in an encoding Kindly Bartender can’t keep intact, so it wasn’t changed. Turn off read-only in the file’s properties, or save the file as UTF-8, and try again.

data.name: Settings.Notify.Note
data.value: Nothing happens while Hearthstone is the active window.

data.name: Settings.DoNotDisturb
data.value: Do not disturb is on, so notifications may be hidden. To let them through, add Kindly Bartender to priority notifications in Windows settings.

data.name: About.Unofficial
data.value: Kindly Bartender is an unofficial fan project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Blizzard Entertainment. Hearthstone is a trademark of Blizzard Entertainment, Inc.

data.name: About.Risk
data.value: Blizzard’s End User License Agreement forbids programs it hasn’t authorized from reading game data, and Blizzard could take action against your account. Use Kindly Bartender at your own risk.

data.name: About.Files.Heading
data.value: What Kindly Bartender reads and changes

data.name: About.Files.Body
data.value: It reads Hearthstone’s Power.log while the game runs. After you agree, it changes log settings in two files: {0}, {1}. Uninstalling doesn’t undo these changes, because other tools may use them. To undo them, delete the [Power] section from the first file and the FileSizeLimit.Int line from the second.

data.name: About.Privacy.Body
data.value: Kindly Bartender collects no personal data and sends nothing about you or your games. At startup it checks GitHub for a new version, so GitHub sees your IP address, as with any web request.

data.name: About.DiagnosticLog.Note
data.value: The diagnostic log contains no account names. You can attach it to a problem report.
